Notes:
----------
*	There was a 1.15 second dropout at 2:06 in Jimi Thing.  I
	edited this spot to fix the problem.  I had another CD
	source for this show from Tom Bernhard and the ~ 1 second
	dropout was also present there.  The edit was done since
	I could not find a clean source for this track.
*	Some of the encore break was not present on the DAT, so
	a crossfade was inserted to smooth this spot out.

*  compiled by Louie Rendek <<email>> on December 29, 2002.
*  mastered over a period in February, 2009.
